headline: 23 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Three Queens Fire in WA, threatening 191 structures.

active_threats.name: Three Queens
active_threats.narrative: The Three Queens Fire in Kittitas County, WA has burned 9,583 acres and is 90% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **191 structures threatened**. 3 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 23 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (SW) is not currently aligned toward Easton CDP, the nearest community of size, 13 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over CA: Santa Clarita city, Oxnard city, Simi Valley city, Camarillo city, and Castaic CDP and 4 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and SPC's **Elevated** fire-weather category. USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 5% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
